_comment: Curated watch roles for the trends ledger (ADR-0051, amended by ADR-0052): roles worth their own trend line inside a family's drill. Matched on TITLE patterns (case-insensitive regex, so \bSRE\b-style capitals are cosmetic), so membership is explainable per Job and survives a new classifier head. `parent` is the role_families.json family whose drill the role appears under; headstart.roles.load_watchlist validates it exists. Since ADR-0220 the parents are taxonomy-v3 families, and each role sits under the family its title means: full stack and backend under software-engineering, frontend under frontend-web, each -by-title role under its concept family, the AI roles under ai-ml-data-science. Java and Python are watch roles because a language is not a family on the one-axis list. ADR-0051 scoped this to roles too small to earn a centroid, and ADR-0052 widened it to the large domain roles the centroids could not separate (backend, frontend, ...); the centroids are retired (ADR-0220), and the roles stay as the facets a one-axis family list leaves out. Watch roles RE-COUNT Jobs already counted in their family, corpus-wide by title rather than within the parent family - they are an overlay, never a partition, and are excluded from the share denominator. The `-by-title` suffix disambiguates the four roles whose concept ALSO exists as a top-level family (qa-test, security, devops, sre-platform): same idea, different population, so they must not share a name. Keep patterns precise: a loose pattern quietly inflates a series forever. Keep each parent within app.js's CHART_MAX (8) - beyond it a role greys out instead of plotting; tests/test_role_watchlist_config.py reads that constant so the two cannot drift.
